findings.summary: Current-descendant enumeration includes its own transient enumeration shell, omits reparented jobs, and does not verify reaping; profile-name grep cannot establish full owned-job absence.
findings.counterexample: Command parent exits during timeout while a child survives reparented without a profile marker; collector no longer owns/discovers it.
findings.minimal_closure: Record/verify stable owned execution boundary; exclude enumeration helpers; retain ownership across parent exit; bounded TERM/KILL and final reap/absence evidence; no unowned signalling.

findings.summary: Cleanup failure is excluded from SUCCESS/process exit; final source identity only printed; exit-record writer status unchecked before success sentinel.
findings.counterexample: FIRST_FAIL empty, no anomalies, CLEAN_RC=2 yields SUCCESS and exit 0.
findings.minimal_closure: Require cleanup success, final exact clean source and validated durable record before success marker; preserve first failure and cleanup separately; nonzero overall if cleanup/publication fails.

findings.summary: Supplied redirect targets absent runs directory; outer timeout optional and signal/grace/supervisor contract unspecified; commands outside step timeout can hang.
findings.counterexample: Initial documented command fails redirection before runner mkdir; after correcting that ad hoc, an unwrapped provenance command can block without mandatory outer deadline.
findings.minimal_closure: One frozen exact launcher creates/reserves output before redirection, mandates total timeout and owned signal target, bounds cleanup grace, and preserves supervisor receipts; separately authorize targeted safety controls.

findings.summary: Reused output directories/sentinels permitted; first wildcard ZIP selected; inventory hashes checked against HEAD but actual ZIP hash not joined to inventory or browser receipts; external probe/predecessor approved hashes not enforced.
findings.counterexample: Existing output contains an earlier selected ZIP with changed bytes and unchanged exact-head inventory; newly written package is not necessarily selected, and old inventory can pass binding.
findings.minimal_closure: Fresh exclusive safe run directory; explicit sole new package selection; ZIP/inventory/member/HEAD and browser hash equality; enforce approved runner/probe/predecessor hashes before execution.

findings.summary: Setup/assertion/evidence failures recorded only as anomalies do not inhibit later required steps.
findings.counterexample: Missing installed hook or unreadable Vitest JSON records anomaly yet can continue to package/browser.
findings.minimal_closure: Latch blocking prerequisite/evidence failures with truthful reason and exit; affected steps NOTRUN; keep intentional expected-negative semantics distinct.
